title: Sr. Lead Platform Engineer
description_html: Sr. Lead Platform Engineer      The ideal candidate will work with senior leaders to deliver results across a broad portfolio of initiatives and is comfortable thinking strategically.  This leader will  identify opportunities and leverage the team to translate them into live solutions.        We are seeking a candidate with a strong track record of delivering successful and productive experiences in a broad collaboration ecosystem.  You will be delivering sophisticated capabilities across many use cases within a dynamic array of business and technology constraints.         In this role you will bring together key stakeholders across product, tech, risk, cyber, and lines of business together to drive strategy and execute on high priority, strategic initiatives. You will be able to deliver outsized and measurable outcomes by defining and guiding objectives, roadmaps, cross organization collaboration, progress and technical requirements for our Teams.  This will require ability to communicate across technical and non-technical stakeholders and manage strategic initiatives with a deep focus on execution and follow-through, accountability and results.               Responsibilities:     Design, document, and maintain the enterprise-wide Google Workspace Collaboration Platform      Design, document, and maintain the enterprise-wide Microsoft M365 Collaboration Platform      Partner with Product and Risk stakeholders to translate business objectives and risk tolerance into platform configurations, security practices, and data handling policies.      Partner with Access team on the IAM strategy for Google Workspace and/or M365, including multi-factor authentication, SSO integration, and context-aware access policies.      Partner with key stakeholders to architect, implement, and manage a robust content management program for Google Drive to prevent unauthorized sharing of sensitive data.      Maintain and execute lifecycle-based governance processes for third-party applications accessing Workspace data, including risk assessments and security audits.      Ensure the Google Workspace platform meets or exceeds regulatory and legal framework requirements through proper configuration, operation, and auditing.      Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and HR to apply Google Vault data retention, eDiscovery, and legal holds correctly.      Identify automation opportunities for repetitive administrative tasks, partnering with the K&P SWE team where appropriate.      Provide prompt and effective technical support to users, troubleshooting issues and answering questions        Monitor system performance, security, and data integrity, taking proactive measures to address potential problems      Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Workspace features and best practices, implementing updates and improvements as needed      Develop and maintain clear documentation and training materials for users      Focus on building and maintaining the underlying operational aspects of the platform including remediating vulnerabilities      Monitor platform support Slack channels and address customer questions and issues      Work closely with the Architecture team to align the platforms to latest architecture and configuration      Encourage innovation, automation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, inclusion, outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization and diversity to a legacy process      Develop, and utilize best practices to enhance the overall user experience of the platform      Collaborate with the Software Engineers to ensure software works seamlessly on the platforms      Work with product owners to understand desired application capabilities and testing scenarios      Continuously improve platform engineering practices and proactively identify risks and execute strategies that eliminate or mitigate those risks      Work within and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement and support technical solutions across a full-stack of development tools and technologies      Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends, experiment with and learn new technologies, participate in internal & external technology communities, and mentor other members of the engineering community      Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, inclusion, outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization and diversity      Directly and indirectly lead a teams of engineers and people leaders to build strategy for each platform and drive being Well Managed, the core goal at Capital One      Utilize scripting languages like Python, Bash, and others.           We want you if you are:      Intellectually Curious. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.      Communicator & Influencer. You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating clearly to partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.      Do-er. You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade-offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team.       Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when exploring unknown technologies.      Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You are also able to coach others and be a mentor.       Basic Qualifications:       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.      At least 6 years of cumulative experience in enterprise information technology, systems engineering, or cybersecurity roles.      At least 4 years of direct, hands-on experience architecting, administering, and securing a large-scale (1,000+ user) Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 collaboration environment.      Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or managing services across SaaS, IaaS, and PaaS cloud environments.        Preferred Qualifications:       Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, an MBA with a technology focus, or equivalent practical experience.      Current Google Certified - Associate Google Workspace Administrator certification is strongly preferred.      Acknowledged expertise with the content and objectives of the retired Professional Google Workspace Administrator certification is also highly valued as an indicator of advanced experience.      6+ years of experience administering Google Workspace or a similar enterprise productivity suite or 6+ years of experience administering Microsoft M365 or a similar enterprise productivity suite      Experience with Google GenAI / LLM platforms and other Agentic or SaaS AI capabilities      6+ years of experience using build and deployment tools (Jenkins, GitHub, or Artifactory)      4 + years of experience in scripting (Powershell, Python, Bash)      4+ years of experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, Cloudformation, CDK, or others.      2+ year of experience in the financial or tech industry        At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, or another type of work authorization).        The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.    McLean, VA: $200,700 - $229,100 for Sr. Lead Platform Engineer    New York, NY: $219,000 - $249,900 for Sr. Lead Platform Engineer    Plano, TX: $182,500 - $208,300 for Sr. Lead Platform Engineer    Richmond, VA: $182,500 - $208,300 for Sr. Lead Platform Engineer                                Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.    This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.    Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the     Capital One Careers website  . Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.    This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. title: Lead Software Engineer, PKI & Cryptographic Trust Services
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        The Experience  Salesforce Data Security is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to architect, build, and scale our unified certificate Registration Authority (RA), the front door for cryptographic trust across our global multi-cloud platform. This foundational trust layer authenticates and authorizes millions of certificate issuance requests daily, securing machine-to-machine communication, workload identity, and data-in-transit for the world's most trusted enterprise cloud. You lead the technical design and delivery of a highly concurrent, multi-substrate Go codebase, stay deep in the code while mentoring senior engineers, and drive architectural consensus across a distributed system where availability and security are non-negotiable. This is an AI-first engineering team: you use advanced AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, and shared-system-context tools daily to accelerate your workflows, review code, and generate comprehensive tests, setting the standard for AI-augmented software development.    What You'll Actually Be Doing    Architect, build, and maintain the unified Registration Authority (RA) that serves as the single certificate-issuance front door for a global, multi-cloud platform.    Design and optimize highly concurrent, multi-substrate build paths in Go, ensuring seamless deployment across diverse public-cloud environments.    Develop and scale both synchronous and asynchronous certificate issuance paths using robust distributed state-machine orchestration.    Implement strictly evaluated hierarchical policy engines and authorization controls to validate substrate-specific workload identity and attestation.    Drive robust certificate lifecycle management and automation by integrating with and abstracting multiple public and private Certificate Authorities (CAs).    Lead the team's engineering excellence by writing resilient, observable, and strictly tested code capable of surviving underlying infrastructure degradation.    Instrument comprehensive telemetry, distributed tracing, and alerting to maintain stringent availability and performance service level agreements (SLAs).    Act as a technical multiplier, mentoring engineers, conducting rigorous code reviews, and raising the bar for distributed systems design.    Partner with Security Architecture to translate complex compliance requirements into automated, scalable software controls.    Respond to and resolve complex distributed systems escalations, identifying root causes and deploying durable architectural fixes.    Elevate team productivity by establishing best practices for AI-augmented software development and prompt engineering.    Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow, pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.    Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.    Contribute to building and maintaining shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably, and critically evaluate code (human- or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance.      You're Our Person If...    You have 9+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale distributed systems.    You have deep, production-grade expertise in Go (Golang), Java, or Rust, including advanced concurrency patterns, memory management, and multi-substrate build configurations.    You have extensive experience deploying and operating highly available, mission-critical services across public cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).    You can design resilient Representational State Transfer (RESTful) and gRPC web services, backed by robust distributed state machines and asynchronous processing pipelines.    You have a strong background in observability (telemetry, distributed tracing, metrics) and modern continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) deployment pipelines.    You are proficient with AI coding assistants and shared-context workflows that enhance engineering velocity.    You have a demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering, using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.    You have experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.    You have advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.    You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.      Even Better If...    You have deep domain knowledge of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), X.509 certificate profiles, and mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS) architectures.    You have a strong understanding of certificate lifecycle management and automated certificate provisioning.    You are aware of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, such as Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM), and crypto-agility design principles.    You have experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and Infrastructure-as-Code paradigms.    You are familiar with designing or operating multi-tenant policy engines and hierarchical authorization graphs.             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.        Posting Statement     Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.    Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.    Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.       In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits.  Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.                        At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.&#xa;&#xa;The typical base salary range for this position is $172,500 - $260,100 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $207,800 - $285,800 annually.&#xa;&#xa;The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.
